newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks gain ground, close higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks gain ground, close higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks gained ground and closed higher on Monday's settlement day as traders settled old short positions after carry-forward rates went up, dealers said.
The KArachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index closed 14.23 points, or 1.00 percent, higher at 1,432.96 amid 102 gainers and 111 losers.

The previous trend of negative carry forward rates had changed and, except fot Fauji Fertilizer, all stocks were rolled over at positive carry forward rates, signifying that old short positions had now been squared, one dealer said.

The market seems to have stabilised before an expected International Monetary Fund announcement on disbursements from a stalled $600 million standby loan, a dealer of Ali Hussain Rajabali said. Siemens rose 15 rupees to 140, Philips 4.00 to 86, PSO 2.75 to 338.75, HUBCO 0.45 to 33.15 and PTCL 0.20 to 32.15. Muslim Commercial Bank fell 1.00 to 37.70.
